summary: CVR Energy filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement for a marketed follow-on offering of 10,515,248 common shares at $47.55 per share, grossing roughly $500 million; shares last traded at $48.60 on November 3, 2026, implying a modest discount. The issuer intends to use net proceeds with cash and other Financing Transactions to fund an unidentified Acquisition and redeem 2028 Notes. The offering is not contingent on the acquisition closing, and shares remain outstanding regardless. Barclays and Jefferies are joint book-runners; a 30-day 1,577,287-share greenshoe applies. This is a routine equity shelf takedown, not itself a special situation, though deal financing and redemption details warrant monitoring.
